3.4.5.2 LdCom user generation
Similar to Com users, the LdCom user concept explained in document [17] supports a
flexible number of callbacks with LdCom user specific LdCom user callback han-
dle Ids.
Those LdCom user callback handle Ids identify to which LdCom
IPdu the notification belongs and are intended to directly index the Rte’s internal data
structures.
Like for the Com users, the LdComUserModuleCnf containers are in-
tended to be setup manually by the integrator. This supports to statically configure the
LdCom users with its LdComUserModule.LdComUserModuleCnfRef references in
the LdCom module. Since the kind of notifications are strongly dependent from the
features used by integrated SWCs and the RTE’s implementation strategy, it’s the task
of the RTE Generator to create the configuration parameters underneath the LdCo-
mUserModuleCnf container.
